review:
Big Bass Secrets of the Golden Lake offers two different free spins rounds. Up to five scatters award as many as 20 free spins, and the bonus begins with a card reveal: pick from 12 cards, two of which unlock the Golden Lake feature instead of the classic round.

In Golden Lake free spins, the fisherman can hook gold diamonds to rewind the reels and catch more prizes, offering larger potential rewards than the standard mode. Both versions include a meter that can add extra free spins and higher multipliers, and every four fishermen award 10 more spins with a progressive multiplier. Pragmatic Play doesn't list a max win for this title. The 96.07% RTP is standard for recent series entries.
